dimensions.assessment: Affects VA employees who process claims, contractors performing examinations, and veterans filing claims based on military sexual trauma.
dimensions.evidence: each employee of the Department who processes such a claim, communicates with a claimant regarding evidence supporting such a claim, or decides such a claim

dimensions.assessment: Improves claims handling, mandatory annual sensitivity training, and record collection standards for sensitive claims.
dimensions.evidence: ensures that a veteran who makes such a claim is not retraumatized during such an examination by such a contracted health care professional.

dimensions.assessment: No specific appropriations or dollar amounts are provided in the source material.
Amends title 38 of the United States Code regarding training requirements and the duty to assist claimants.
dimensions.evidence: Subsection (c) of section 1166 of title 38, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing annual training and reporting mandates.
dimensions.evidence: receives annual sensitivity training and training... not less than once annually.

missing_information: Exact cost of implementing the annual training programs and expanded record gathering
importance_detail.rationale: The bill updates VA processing for military sexual trauma claims by mandating annual sensitivity training for relevant employees and broadening the duty to obtain service medical and personnel records.
